Title: Osney Bridge diversion, Oxford
Description: Towpath closed about 150 yards from Osney Bridge due to riverbank repairs. Diversion via Abbey Road and Botley Road.

Title: Marsh Lock footbridge closure, Henley
Description: Footbridge closed for safety. Diversion via A4155 pavements, approximately 3 miles. Train/bus alternative available between Henley and Shiplake.

Title: Sandford Footbridge closure
Description: Unsafe footbridge closed north (upstream) of Sandford Lock. Diversion via NCN 5.

Title: Abingdon Weir intermittent closure
Description: Weir walkway closed due to corrosion. Rerouted via Abingdon town centre. May reopen if river levels are low but will close again when levels rise.

Title: Goring/Streatley towpath diversion
Description: Half mile diversion away from eroding Thames due to erosion south of Streatley/Goring Bridge. Riverside route unlikely to reopen until late 2026.

Title: Temple Footbridge closure near Marlow
Description: Footbridge closed since May 2023 due to structural problems with deck boards. Diversion via Marlow Bridge and Bisham Road (via Temple Lane and Marlow Road).

Title: Bridge 142 closure near Egham
Description: Footbridge closed due to structural damage from flooding. Diversion via A308 pavements and underpass, approx 0.6 miles. Expected closure until at least 2026, possibly 2027.

Title: Bell Weir Lock diversion, Runnymede
Description: Small diversion at Runnymede Pleasure Ground around construction compound for Bell Weir refurbishment (spring 2026 to autumn 2027). Lock remains operational.

Title: Penton Hook Island closure
Description: Island closed to public due to diseased trees (ash dieback). Tree clearance work planned; unsafe for access. Thames Path itself unaffected.

Title: Ten Foot Bridge closure, Faringdon
Description: Footbridge closed since March 2024 due to structural and safety concerns. Located between Rushey and Shifford locks near Buckland.

Title: Brentford Grand Union Canal disruption
Description: Path blocked on left bank of Grand Union Canal between bridge over River Brent and Brentford Marina. Alternative via The Ham, canal walk to Thames Lock, then Dock Road.
